OTHER PINBALLS     	 :	-ROAD GIRLS: Hit the Road of Suscess with 6 of the more
FROM BLINDMANKIND  		beautiful girls you will ever see in a pinball machines!
							A crazy son of a b#tch sheriff, 1000 miles an old picktruck
							and a lot of beautiful southern women in the sexiest pin
							you will ever see.

							-DEAD HUNTERS: Fight ordes of Zombies, Aliens, Demons, Cows
							and all kind of extrange creatures. Stand agaisnt Government
							experiments in one-of-the-hell-innovative history pin.


==============================================================================
	P L A Y    I N F O R M A T I O N
==============================================================================

PLAYERS					 :	1P Only
MODES					 :	Three Angels is a "history pin". This is supposed to be a pinball
							were the history is very important for the game. It's not about
							making big points, get all lights on or the big score ever.
							Three Angels is about getting yourself "into" the game. Fighting
							against Evil and bringing Light into Darkness.
							Of course each	part of the history could be considered a mode,
							but there are no really "modes" as we usually understand them...
							And that's good?... well I think so, but you know... there are a
							6 billion people out there, and everyone has his own opinion. So
							play some games and try to get some fun!

WIZARD MODE			 :	Of course. And in my humble opinion, that's the best part of
							the game. Is a epic battle between Good and Evil forces.
							How you get threre? Well, it's easy, there is a powerfull guy in
							the playfield, they call him the Wishmaster. If you gave him 666
							souls he will open the Gates of Hell for thou!
							BTW: the backglass image is an scene of that final mode.


MULTIBALLS				 :	Sure 2, 3 & 5 Ball Multiballs
BALL SAVER				 :	Yes and the "POWER OF GOD" (that's another special ballsaver)
LANE CHANGE			 : Yes in lower in/out lanes
KICKBACK				 : Not exactly. But you have Christ's Nails...
FLIPPERS				 :	4 (2 Regulars 5" + 2 Smalls 2'5")
BUMPERS					 :	2 (1 more than in RG... in the next pin I will get 3 bumpers?)
CAPTIVE BALLS			 :	1 But it moves. It's really a Captive Angel :)
RAMPS					 : 1, our special "UNHOLY WIRE RAMP" made of sacred metal.
WIDE BODY MACHINE	 :	Nope.
SPECIAL FEATURES		 :	Three Angels has demons, angels, a Wishmaster, Captive guardians
							and a special BLOOD EXTRACTING MACHINE.

OBJECTS					 :	800
TABLE SLOPE			 : 8

OPERATOR'S MENU		 :	Nope
DIFFICULTY SETTINGS	 :	Nope.

NEW SOUNDS				 :	Yes. A lot of them. I hope you like them. And he have two special
							guest: Christopher Lee and Vincent Price. Ain't cool? :)))
NEW SOUNDTRACK		 :	Yes By Alan Silvestrym, Hans Zimmer, Clint Mansell, James Newton
							Howard, Wojciech Kilar and an Italian group called Rapshody.
NEW GRAPHICS			 :	Yes all of them are by Clayton Crain. A real artist! Thanx!
NEW MODELS				 :	Nope...
=============================================================================='
	C O N S T R U C T I O N
=============================================================================='

BASE						 : A new table from hell... I mean from scratch. The only thing
							that I take were the default position of the lower flippers.
							The rest is from a blood whitewood.... I mean a clean whitewood.

BUILD TIME				 : How cares about time. You live you die, and you spent three
							months of your life keeping the pinball rollin'... so what?

EDITORS USED			 :	Future Pinball v1.8
							PhotoShop 7.0 (Man, that's another piece of art)
							Audacity (Amazing free sound editing software)

MACHINE USED			 : HP Pavillion f165.es 2.66Ghz + 512Mb RAM + (NVidiaGForce4 128Mb)
							I get about 30FPS @ 1280x1024 with High Quality Textures but with
							Minimun Detail.

KNOWN BUGS				 :	Well, is a complex pin. It has been tested a lot but... you know...

THINGS THAT I LOVE   : I love being Possesed .... and the Wizard Mode is really really really cool.

THINGS THAT I HATE   : I hate... let me think... being possesed!  arghhh. Damned!



I would like to include a nice phrase that Fluffybot said:

<< Put a man in a room with a thousand books for a year and when he comes out,
chances are he'll be able to recite many lines of literature to you. But if
you put a man in a room with a thousand sheets of paper and a pen, in a year's
time you might find yourself holding a book you've never read before.>>

														I'm totally agree with him.


"Archangel, Dark Angel
Lend me thy light
Through Death's veil
Til we have Heaven in sight!"

=============================================================================='
	C O N S T R U C T o R S !
=============================================================================='
Agaliarept is said to be a demon who is a grand general of Hell and commander of the second legion.
Aamon has forty legions of demons under his command, having the title of prince. Commander of the first legion of Hell.
Baal is cited in the Grand Grimioregeneral of the infernal armies and commander of sixty-six legions
Flauros is a strong Great Duke of Hell, having thirty-six (twenty according to Pseudomonarchia Daemonum)
legions of demons under his rule.
Agares (or Agaures) is a Prince, ruling the eastern zone of Hell, and being served by 31 legions of demons.
Alocer is a powerful demon, Grand Duke of Hell. Thirty six legions are controlled by him.
Foras Grand President and Knight of Hell, commander of twenty-nine legions.
Furfur He is the commander of twenty-six legions.
Haborym (Hebrew) Another name for Satan. A Duke of Hell, commander of twenty-six legions.
Malphas Grand President of Hell, commander of forty legions
Pruflas Grand Prince and Grand Duke of the infernal empire. Commander of twenty-six legions
===========================================
V1.01 - CHANGES
===========================================
-Solved a script DMD typo that abort the game when an angel is destroyed.
-Solved a problem that could happen when you activated the Blacksmith from the Wishmaster.
-2nd time you complete the blacksmith you didn't get the price... not anymore.
-When Midnight Darkness is over lanes could not be lit.
-Adjusted Midnight Darkness timers.
-Manual Nails stay for all the game once they are connected.
-Change behaviour of Guardians when 3 angels are in hell. More fun this way.
-Bonus Hold didn't work right
-Looped a music track that could make the game go silent.
===========================================
V2.0.2 - CHANGES by LoadedWeapon
===========================================
-Updated images for 4k playfield and videos
-Fixed some broken lights
-Updated Lighting for 10.8
-Fixed some script errors
-Updated Sounds
-10.8 POV and New Sidewalls
-New Flippers
-Updated Physics (nFozzy) table objects,script
-Misc fixes for bugs and lost balls
-Tons of other stuff I can't remember
-Fixed Lut Save
-Fixed Upper Bumper Area and trapped ball
-Fixed Duplicated Flipper sounds and some other sounds
-I spent a lot of time updating this amazing table and I hope you enjoy it! :)
